name: Minami Yukio
source:
He is just your ordinary main character... or is he?!
If only he would stop daydreaming in class, he would probably score much better in school!
He can be a little bad tempered and sarcastic too. 
Yukio is sweet and a hard working boy with problems in his personality cause of the bullying he has been suffering on school since early. He's also curious and kind, and will do everything in his power to help someone in need. He dreams about being a famous chef or a mangaka in the future.
